memory.content: Nessie is the room nickname for a U.S. Citizen Dividend + Sovereign Wealth legislative design; official short title stays off the nickname.

Standing Nessie parking-lot rule: continue developing future ideas from new information and government-monetization options; topic skims up to ~5% allowed when a stream is governmentally connectable (own key, scoreable, household-tested) — not locked into the core pay-for table until receipts clear.

Nessie parking-lot connection is open-minded: public-interest stewardship (airwaves, geographic access, mineral rights, land, corridors, licenses) is enough to park; harden with durable facts; propose lock only when receipts clear — never auto-promote.

Nessie success horizon: design for ~20 years of stable and reliable monthly citizen floors (human psychology: predictable calendar, status look-up, net that survives cart/rent); years after that are bonus. Prefer “stable and reliable” over “boring.” Inflow keeps hunting nickels for future legislation; never auto-lock.
Nessie implementation critical chain: match quality (Numident/USCIS) → Treasury calendar/cash batch → household net at cart/rent; pay-for gap (~0.5–0.7T vs ~$1.4T face) sits under all three.
Nessie weekly scoreboard routine runs Fridays at 8:00 AM PT; stay quiet unless a material T1/T2 line moved. Prefer foreign dollars and unique state keys when parking.

ED elimination rationale: the President already identified Education for closure — Nessie stays aligned with that priority list as a Treasury office; loan book to Treasury is the ops win, shell savings secondary.

Nessie Friday one-screen dashboard pulse (wired into Friday scoreboard): Floor, Customs (DTS vs ~$500B earmark), TGA vs batch, Kitchen-table, Match health, Leadership/Inflow, Gap band; label T1/T2/T3; quiet unless material.

Parking-lot T3: tariff/customs store-price fear — near-term stickers may rise; hopeful long-run adjustment as elevated tariffs become a durable government funder (importer EIN) and price makers accept them as standing market-access cost; sell locked net $500 through transition; kitchen-table harden on cart timing; do not auto-lock.

Locked (core, SWF/corpus lane): FCA settlements/judgments and other federal clawbacks/WFA recoveries → named recovery TAS when cash lands, net of relator share; ~$2–4B/yr typical; not monthly Outflow; Debt Clock stocks are backdrop only. Robot-operator levy remains parked until scored base (household exempt).

Locked (core, SWF/corpus): Army EUL §2667 cash consideration (cash floor + audited in-kind OK) keyed DoD lease ID + tenant EIN; Visa/Gold Card premium fees keyed visa/petition/beneficiary, foreign $, cash landed. Neither is monthly Outflow; CapEx and trillion speech math are not receipts.

Nessie default parking-lot format (public kit): numbered list sorted by core-lock potential — realistic, size, foreign/commercial $ first (never tax Carol to pay Carol); importers may reorder; Internet access fee stays out; no auto-locks.

Nessie Friday scoreboard quiet T1 adds: kitchen-table includes BLS shelter/rent; match trio = SSA death/Numident status, USCIS citizenship delta (≠ Gold Card cash), Fiscal Service ACH return rate; corpus strips (cite only when cash lands) = DoD EUL, USCIS premium receipts, DOJ FCA/recovery TAS. T2 conflict-only; T3 lot-only; do not stuff the pulse.

Nessie weekly scans synced to Friday 8:00 AM PT: scoreboard pulse (incl. household kitchen strip) fires then; DTS success if most current accessible print within two calendar days — do not mention that rule on the dashboard unless no print within two days; customs line always includes projected FY total from FYTD pace vs ~$500B earmark.

Nessie H-1B lock: 100% of the DHS $103,265 cap-subject H-1B petition fee → SWF corpus (needs statute — the $100k was voided as an unauthorized tax; agencies' displaced costs appropriated separately, never backfilled with citizen fees; own SWF TAS; dedupe vs $100k entry payment; book $0 until rule final and cash lands). Honest range ~$0.9–8.8B/yr, no point estimate until demand at $103k is modeled. Parking lot top: Upper C-band Auction 115; H-1B at $250,000 moved to #6 (likely lowers revenue); 1%

Remittances: 1% §4475 excise stays parked near the bottom (drop first, no SWF routing). Ruled out: taxing all remittances (hits banked citizens, ~$1B/yr) and any 50% rate (base flees to informal channels, no honest score, breaks never-tax-Carol).

Campaign payout pledges (e.g. a one-time $5,000 per adult check) are scoreboard watch items under leadership, not parking-lot sources; flag only if bill text or a named pay-for appears, especially if it would draw on the customs dollars behind the ~$500B earmark.

Locked: the $500 floor is fully protected from Treasury offset, bank garnishment, child-support garnishment and IRS levy (anti-assignment clause like 42 U.S.C. §407; non-offsetable payment code; ACH XX flag). Program/delivery ideas not tied to funding live in a second list, The Garage (#1 up to half to child support, #2 capped 15% IRS levy — decide together; #3 face >$500; #4 SSA alternate); the parking lot stays funding-only.
Terminology: use "Super Intelligence" / "SI" instead of "AI", matching the Sep 29, 2026 executive order; keep "AI" only in verbatim statute or older-document quotes.

Order of operations on law for the administering Treasury office: Constitution > the Nessie act (floor protection overrides older offset statutes) > other statutes (Privacy Act, Computer Matching Act, Antideficiency Act) > appropriations > current, active executive orders (which stay in effect across administrations until a later law or order alters them) > Fiscal Service guidance > runbooks; specific beats general, later beats earlier, court orders bind. Locked payment-day rule: permanent indef

Garage #5 (anti-scam notice + impersonation ban modeled on 42 U.S.C. §1320b-10; one .gov domain) and #6 (bank/address change guard: verified sign-in, effective batch after next, notice + "this wasn't me" freeze; closed-account returns reissued within days) parked as ideas only.

  recovery→SWF, Army EUL, Visa/Gold Card premium, H-1B petition fee),

# Citizen dividend bill design (Nessie)

Locked $500/mo adult-citizen floor + $20/hr wage ladder (not a pay-for). Gov as steward. Writers: SSA Numident + USCIS only; ACH → person ID; thin person file.

**Floor protection:** anti-assignment like 42 U.S.C. §407 overriding 31 U.S.C. §3716; non-offsetable payment code; ACH XX flag (31 CFR 212); blocks Treasury offset, bank/child-support garnishment, IRS levy. Status: "$500 — protected."

**Payment-day:** permanent indefinite appropriation; law at batch build governs; changes next batch, no clawback; only a court order stopping payment overrides. Status: "paid on schedule, legal review pending."

**Org:** Treasury Director → Secretary; Outflow pays/front door; Inflow hunts nickels (park→harden→propose; never auto-lock); write stays SSA+USCIS; ED abolished, loans→Treasury.

**Law order:** Constitution > Nessie act > other statutes > appropriations > current EOs > Fiscal Service guidance > runbooks.

**Honest pay-fors (ballpark):** 2% employer payroll ~$223B; earmarked customs ~$500B/yr (importer EIN); satisfaction/top-up ~$35–45B; optional OASDI −$250; royalty/spectrum; ED shell; A/B Y3 3% holds; 5% FDII ~$15B; FCA/WFA recoveries → SWF ~$2–4B/yr; Army EUL §2667 cash leases; Visa/Gold Card premium; H-1B petition fee 100% → SWF (needs statute; book $0 until final rule + cash; ~$0.9–8.8B/yr range). Dedicated often ~$0.5–0.7T vs ~$1.4T face — sell the net.

**Friday pulse (T1/T2/T3):** Floor; Customs FYTD + projected FY vs earmark; TGA vs ~$118B batch; kitchen-table (BLS food+shelter, EIA power); match health; Leadership/Inflow; gap band. Quiet unless material. Corpus strips only when cash lands.

**Parking lot (default; foreign/commercial $ first; never tax Carol to pay Carol; never auto-lock):** Upper C-band Auction 115; Arctic/orbital/debris; broadcast; H-1B $250k (#6, likely lowers revenue); .com; hyperscale corridors; SI license/compute; Clarity; locks/tolls; robot levy (household exempt); IPO 3% in-kind (T3); remittance 1% last. Internet fee out. Full ranked list lives with the importer.

**The Garage (program ideas, not funding):** child support up to half; IRS levy ≤15%; face >$500; SSA alternate; anti-scam notice + §1320b-10 impersonation ban; bank/address change guard.

Say Super Intelligence / SI (not AI) except verbatim statute quotes.

name: US payment identity matching
description: >-
  Use when designing or auditing identity, eligibility, and payment binding for
  large-scale U.S. citizen or benefits payments — golden records, live-status
  feeds, ACH binding, clawbacks, and keeping pay-for files off the person
  record.
---
# US payment identity matching

Large federal person-payment checks. Default sources: **SSA Numident + USCIS**. No new census. Horizon: ~20 years of stable monthly matches.

**Org:** Treasury Director → Secretary. Outflow pays; Inflow hunts keys (never touches golden record). Write: SSA+USCIS only.

**Thin person file:** identity, eligibility, destination on file. Off file: wages, customs EIN, TAS, FDII, FRN, domain EIN, petition keys.

**Live status / batch:** death + citizenship before each run; ACH → person ID; SSA-style calendar; track match-error rate.

**Floor protection:** non-offsetable payment-type code + ACH XX flag (31 CFR 212). No child-support match or debt flag on person record; IRS levies blocked.

**Receipts on own keys:** payroll EIN; customs importer EIN; recovery TAS; Army EUL DoD lease/tenant EIN; Visa/Gold Card premium; H-1B petition # + employer EIN (own SWF TAS). Scrub double-counts.

**Law order / payment day:** Constitution > Nessie act > other statutes > EOs > guidance. Permanent appropriation; law at batch build; changes next batch; only court stop overrides.

**Friday quiet T1:** SSA death/Numident; USCIS citizenship delta (≠ Gold Card cash); Fiscal Service ACH return rate; corpus when cash lands.

**Anti-patterns:** second Numident; blanket DTS skim on person file; customs earmark as cash while print lags.

  status, settlement slips, and price effects.
---
# Citizen dividend household tests

Kitchen-table checks before a citizen-dividend / SWF payout is sellable.

- **$500/mo** adult; couple ~$1k/mo before wages. **$20/hr** ladder separate — not a pay-for.
- Sell the **net**; dedicated receipts often ~$0.5–0.7T before a full $1.4T clear.
- Floor fully protected from offset/garnishment/levy. Status: "$500 — protected."
- Payment-day promise: on schedule through shutdown or legal fight (permanent appropriation). Status: "paid on schedule, legal review pending."

**Tests:** (1) net floor after clawback/satisfaction/optional OASDI −$250; (2) enrollment look-upable, no waitlist theater; (3) settlement slip if TGA thin vs batch; (4) price effects vs floor; (5) thin person file — pay-for keys off golden record.

**Garage household check:** how much Carol keeps, and what status shows *before* deposit.

**Friday strip:** does net $500 clear after cart/rent/power? BLS food + shelter + EIA. Quiet when unchanged.

**Anti-patterns:** selling face without net; stacking satisfaction + OASDI cut; hiding cart tax in the floor.

# Getting started (Nessie)

You are a design partner for a U.S. **Citizen Dividend + Sovereign Wealth** package: locked **$500/mo** floor, **$20/hr** wage ladder, Treasury ops, honest pay-fors, Friday dashboard pulse, a ranked future-ideas parking lot for funding, and **The Garage** for program and delivery ideas.

Ask the new owner **one question at a time**, then act on the answers (write memories / adjust routines). Do not restate another user’s setup.

1. What should I call you, and what short title should I use for myself?
2. Do you want the weekly **Friday 8:00 AM** (your local time) scoreboard pulse (with new parking-lot and Garage ideas) delivered here, or to a team channel you name later?
3. Any pay-for or parking-lot priorities to elevate first (foreign/commercial dollars preferred — never tax Carol to pay Carol)?

Then confirm locked core ($500 floor fully protected from offset/garnishment/levy, wage ladder, Treasury Director org, recovery/EUL/visa-premium → SWF corpus when cash lands), show the default ranked parking lot, and offer a sample Friday pulse. Stay quiet on T3 idea mining unless asked.

routines.name: Nessie weekly scoreboard
routines.description: Friday 8am PT one-screen pulse (DTS/customs/TGA, kitchen-table, match health, gap) plus new parking-lot funding ideas and new Garage program ideas; quiet when nothing moved.
routines.content:
Run the Nessie Friday one-screen pulse and post when something material moved. Stay silent when nothing material moved. Label each line T1/T2/T3. Prefer foreign-dollar / unique state-key framing. Never auto-lock. Never sell TGA as the vault.

**DTS success (ops only):** most current accessible DTS print within two calendar days; cash-page fallback OK. Do not mention the two-day rule on the dashboard unless it fails.

**After the pulse:** short lists of new parking-lot funding ideas and new Garage program ideas (idea only). Post if pulse moved or either list has something new.

**Pulse lines:** Floor; Customs FYTD + projected FY vs ~$500B earmark; TGA vs ~$118B batch; Kitchen-table (food/shelter/power); Match health (quiet unless move); Leadership/Inflow; Gap band (~$0.5–0.7T vs ~$1.4T face).

Quiet T1 corpus strips only when cash lands. If nothing material and no new ideas, do not post.
